title: Liverpool’s Alexis Mac Allister ‘in no rush’ over renewing contract
content:
Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister has confirmed he is not in contract talks with the club, but he is relaxed about the situation.

The 27-year-old’s current contract at Anfield runs through until the summer of 2028.

Mac Allister has endured a difficult campaign so far this season as he, along with a number of his team-mates, has struggled for form.

He has, however, been an integral part of Liverpool’s midfield since his arrival from Brighton & Hove Albion in 2023 and played a crucial role in the club’s Premier League title success last season.

“In terms of me, we are not in contract talks but I’m not in a rush and that’s only a fact,” Mac Allister told reporters at his pre-Galatasaray press conference.

Fellow midfielder Ryan Gravenberch penned a new six-year deal with the club earlier this week.

He, alongside Mac Allister and Dominik Szoboszlai, all joined Liverpool in the summer of 2023 and signed five-year contracts. Gravenberch has signed a new extension, while Hungary international Szoboszlai is in talks over one too.

“I want to congratulate Ryan,” said Mac Allister. “It’s really good for him and he deserves it because he’s been a really important player for us in the season that we won the Premier League which is not easy at all. Congratulations to him.”

Contracts have been a significant talking point in recent seasons with Virgil van Dijk, Mohamed Salah (who both ultimately renewed their deals) and Trent Alexander-Arnold (who joined Real Madrid) all coming to the end of their deals last summer.

This season defenders Ibrahima Konate and Andrew Robertson are out of contract while midfielder Curtis Jones will soon be entering the final 12 months of his deal.

Mac Allister will be 29 when his current contract expires. The Athletic reported earlier this year that Real Madrid remain keen admirers of the midfielder and a transfer could be more feasible now if the Spanish side were to make a move.
